_comment: EDIT THIS FILE to change the gear shop. Drop an image into the images/ folder, then add its filename below. The character's name in the game is the filename without the extension (Character1.jpg -> 'Character1', 'Sonic the hero.gif' -> 'Sonic the hero'). Every character costs the same: costPerCharacter coins. To override the price of one character, use the object form {"file": "...", "cost": 350}.
